'''Electromagnetic load lifters'''<ref name="SWS" /> or '''magnetic lifters'''<ref name="EGVV">''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref> were devices used for loading and unloading cargo. They were installed on [[Skiff/Legends|skiffs]]; two electromagnetic load lifters were utilized on the [[Bantha-II cargo skiff/Legends|Bantha-II cargo skiff]].<ref name="SWS" />
